303.description: redirect to the configured success or failure URL

502.description: provider rejected the token or profile request

post.description: Enqueue a re-sync of the given connection over a closed time window [from, to]. Returns 202 immediately; clients poll GET /monobank/connections to watch sync_status. last_synced_at is preserved across the operation.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Window end (unix seconds, >= from). Clamped to now if in the future.

charges.description: The 20 most recent charges; present on the detail endpoint and omitted from list/update responses.

UpdateSubscriptionRequest.description: An omitted field is unchanged. Product-name and billing-period nulls clear their overrides; status null is invalid and `auto` clears the status override.

product_name.description: A string sets the override; null clears it; omission leaves it unchanged.

billing_period.description: A value sets the override; null clears it; omission leaves it unchanged.

status.description: active/inactive set a manual override; auto clears it; null is invalid; omission leaves it unchanged.

category_id.description: A UUID sets a category owned by the current user; null clears it; omission leaves it unchanged.

base_total.description: Actual charges due in the window, converted to base currency when FX is available.

by_currency.description: Actual charges due in the window, broken down by original currency.

complete.description: False when at least one needed FX quote was unavailable.
